title: CHW app, Onesa (Country B)
description: The OHS app on the community health worker's phone in Onesa (J2), community configuration, offline: adds the newborn to the household (structured data capture), triage-reads a foreign DVC without verifying it (STT-VER-011), saves the doses as reported, not verified, and records a referral. A Receiver that deliberately stops before trust.

parts.title: Smart forms (SDC)
parts.description: The registration and referral forms of the CHW app, FHIR Questionnaires filled in with Structured Data Capture, which also read the doses on a paper DVC (J2).
